source.title: Problems and Conjectures in Matrix and Operator Inequalities

accepted.question_text: For a fixed unitarily invariant norm on complex n x n matrices, determine whether there exists a dimension-independent constant c such that for every pair of matrices A,B in M_n(C) and every concave function f:[0,∞)→[0,∞), the inequality |||f(|A+B|)||| ≤ c |||f(|A|)+f(|B|)||| holds. If such constants exist, characterize or optimize the best possible constant for the chosen norm.

evidence.quote: Problem 1 For a given unitarily invariant norm is there is a constant c such that |||f(|A + B|)||| ≤ c |||f(|A|) + f(|B|)||| (3) holds for all A, B ∈ Mn(C) and for all concave functions f : [0, ∞) → [0, ∞).

accepted.question_text: Let A and B be positive semidefinite matrices and let p,q>0. Determine whether every unitarily invariant norm satisfies |||A^(p+q)+B^(p+q)||| ≤ |||(A^p+B^p)(A^q+B^q)|||.

evidence.quote: Problem 2 (Bourin) Given A, B ≥ 0 and p, q > 0, is it true that ||| A^(p+q) + B^(p+q) ||| ≤ |||(A^p + B^p)(A^q + B^q)|||? (5)

accepted.question_text: Let A and B be positive semidefinite matrices and let p,q>0. Determine whether every unitarily invariant norm satisfies |||A^p B^q + B^p A^q||| ≤ |||A^(p+q)+B^(p+q)|||.

evidence.quote: Problem 3 (Bourin) Given A, B ≥ 0 and p, q > 0, is it true that ||| A^pB^q + B^pA^q ||| ≤ |||A^(p+q) + B^(p+q)|||? (6)

accepted.question_text: Let A and B be positive semidefinite matrices and let p>0. For each singular-value index i, determine whether the Heinz-type singular-value inequality σ_i(A^p B^(1-p)+B^p A^(1-p)) ≤ σ_i(A+B) holds.

evidence.quote: Problem 4 Given A, B ≥ 0 and p > 0, is it true that σi(A^pB^(1−p) + B^pA^(1−p)) ≤ σi(A + B)? (10)

accepted.question_text: Let A and B be positive semidefinite matrices, and let f:[0,∞)→[0,∞) be concave with f(0)≥0, without assuming that f is monotone. Determine whether there always exist unitary matrices U and V such that f(A+B) ≤ U f(A) U* + V f(B) V*.

evidence.quote: Problem 5 Can the condition of monotonicity be dropped? That is, does (11) hold for all concave functions f on [0, +∞) with f(0) ≥ 0?

accepted.question_text: Under the same hypotheses as the unitary-orbit subadditivity inequality for concave functions on positive semidefinite matrices, determine whether one can always find unitary matrices U and V such that 0 ≤ f(A+B)-U f(A) U* ≤ V f(B) V*.

evidence.quote: Problem 6 Can (11) be strengthened to a double inequality? That is, under the various mentioned conditions, do there always exist unitary matrices U and V such that 0 ≤ f(A + B) − Uf(A)U* ≤ V f(B)V*? (12)

accepted.question_text: Let A and B be positive operators. Determine whether the trace inequality Tr(A+B)^q ≤ Tr A^q + Tr B^q + (2q−2) Tr(A^(1/2) B A^(1/2))^(q/2) holds throughout the range −2<q<0, and whether the inequality reverses for all q≥3.

evidence.quote: Conjecture 1 For positive A and B, Tr(A + B)^q ≤ Tr A^q + Tr B^q + (2q − 2) Tr(A^(1/2)BA^(1/2))^(q/2), (20) for −2 < q < 0. For 3 ≤ q the reversed inequality holds.

accepted.question_text: Let X and Y be positive operators, let p≥2, and define the weighted power mean M_t=(tX^p+(1−t)Y^p)^(1/p) for 0≤t≤1. Determine whether the function t ↦ Tr(Y−M_t)^2 is always monotonically increasing.

evidence.quote: Conjecture 2 Let X and Y be positive operators, and 0 ≤ t ≤ 1. Then the function t 7→ Tr(Y − (tX^p + (1 − t)Y^p)^(1/p))^2 increases monotonically for p ≥ 2.

accepted.question_text: For weighted matrix power means μ_t(X,Y), determine for which values of q and under what hypotheses they are monotonic with respect to the L_q metric δ(X,Y)=||X−Y||_q, meaning that t ↦ δ(μ_t(X,Y),Y) is monotone on [0,1].

evidence.quote: Many further questions can be raised. For example, are the power means monotonic in other metrics as well, like the Lq metric δ(X, Y ) = ||X − Y ||q?

accepted.question_text: Let T be a 2 x N partitioned operator with first row blocks A_1,...,A_N and second row blocks B_1,...,B_N, and let C_p(T) be the 2 x N block matrix whose entries are the Schatten p-norms of those blocks. Determine whether ||T||_p ≥ ||C_p(T)||_p for 1≤p≤2 and ||T||_p ≤ ||C_p(T)||_p for p≥2.
accepted.context_brief: Norm compression for 2 x N blocks

evidence.quote: Conjecture 3 Let T be the partitioned operator ... Denoting by Cp(T ) its Schatten p-norm compression ... we have ||T ||p ≥ || Cp(T )||p, 1 ≤ p ≤ 2 (22) ||T ||p ≤ || Cp(T )||p, p ≥ 2. (23)

accepted.question_text: Let A and B be positive definite matrices with Tr(A+B)=1. Determine whether there exists a dimension-independent constant c such that the trace-norm commutator bound ||[B,log(A+B)]||_1 ≤ c(−Tr A log Tr A − Tr B log Tr B) always holds.

evidence.quote: Conjecture 4 Let A, B be positive definite matrices such that Tr(A + B) = 1; then there is a constant c (independent of the dimensions of A and B) such that || [B, log(A + B)] ||1 ≤ c(− Tr A log Tr A − Tr B log Tr B). (26)

accepted.question_text: Let A and B be positive semidefinite d x d matrices with a=Tr A and b=Tr B. Determine for which real-valued functions f there exists a dimension-independent constant c such that ||[B,f(A+B)]||_1 ≤ c(F(a+b)−F(a)−F(b)), where F(x)=∫_0^x f(y)dy.

evidence.quote: Conjecture 5 Let A and B be positive semidefinite d×d matrices with a = Tr A and b = Tr B. For certain functions f(x) : R 7→ R (of a class to be determined) there exists a constant c, independent of d, such that || [B, f(A + B)] ||1 ≤ c(F(a + b) − F(a) − F(b)), (28) where F(x) = R x 0 f(y)dy.

accepted.question_text: Let X and Y be complex n x m matrices, let f:R_+→R_+ be concave with f(0)=0, and let σ_i denote singular values in nonincreasing order. Determine whether for every k≤min(n,m) one has Σ_{i=1}^k |f(σ_i(X))−f(σ_i(Y))| ≤ Σ_{i=1}^k f(σ_i(X−Y)).

evidence.quote: Conjecture 6 (Miao) Let X, Y ∈ Mn,m(C). Let f be a concave function f : R+ 7→ R+ with f(0) = 0. Then for any k ≤ n, m, Σ_{i=1}^k |f(σi(X)) − f(σi(Y ))| ≤ Σ_{i=1}^k f(σi(X − Y )). (30)

accepted.question_text: Let A_0,...,A_{n−1} be operators on a separable Hilbert space. For exponents p and q with 1/p+1/q=1, determine whether the Clarkson-type n-tuple inequalities n(Σ ||A_j||_p^p)^(q/p) ≤ ||Σ A_j||_p^q + Σ_{0≤j<k≤n−1} ||A_j−A_k||_p^q for 2≤p<∞, and the reverse inequality for 0<p≤2, always hold.

evidence.quote: Conjecture 7 Let A0, A1, · · ·, An−1 be operators on a separable Hilbert space. Then ... (46) for 2 ≤ p < ∞ ... and ... (47) for 0 < p ≤ 2.

accepted.question_text: Determine the best dimension-independent constant C, if one exists, such that every norm on M_{N,M}(C) satisfies ||X||+||Y||+||Z||−||X+Y+Z|| ≤ C[(||X||+||Y||−||X+Y||)+(||X||+||Z||−||X+Z||)+(||Y||+||Z||−||Y+Z||)]. In particular, determine the optimal constant C_p for the Schatten p-norm.

evidence.quote: Problem 7 Find the best (dimension-independent) constant C – if it exists – such that ||X|| + ||Y || + ||Z|| − ||X + Y + Z|| ≤ C{(||X|| + ||Y || − ||X + Y ||) + (||X|| + ||Z|| − ||X + Z||) + (||Y || + ||Z|| − ||Y + Z||)} (48) In particular, find the best constant Cp when the norm in question is the Schatten p-norm.

accepted.question_text: Let A_1,...,A_n be positive operators. Determine whether there exists a constant c such that Tr sqrt(Σ_j A_j^2) − Σ_j Tr A_j ≥ c Σ_{j<k}(||A_j−A_k||_1 − Tr(A_j+A_k)) always holds.

evidence.quote: Conjecture 8 Let Aj be n positive operators, then Tr sqrt(Σ_j A_j^2) − Σ_j Tr Aj ≥ c Σ_{j<k}(||Aj − Ak||1 − Tr(Aj + Ak)). (51) where c is a constant.

accepted.question_text: Determine whether the multivariate inequality involving Tr sqrt(Σ_j A_j^2) can be modified so that an analogous statement remains valid for completely general operators, without assuming positivity or normality.

evidence.quote: Furthermore, can the inequality (51) be modified so that it holds for general (non-positive, non-normal) operators?

accepted.question_text: Let p be a polynomial of degree n with p(0)=0 and p'(0)≠0. Determine whether at least one critical point μ_j of p satisfies p(μ_j)/μ_j ≤ p'(0).

evidence.quote: Conjecture 9 (Smale) Let p be a polynomial of degree n such that p(0) = 0 and p'(0) 6= 0. At least one of the roots of p' satisfies p(µj )/µj ≤ p'(0).

accepted.question_text: Let p(z)=(z−λ_1)⋯(z−λ_n) be a polynomial whose roots all lie in the closed unit disk, and let p'(z)=n(z−μ_1)⋯(z−μ_{n−1}). Determine whether for every root λ_i there exists a critical point μ_j with |λ_i−μ_j|≤1.

evidence.quote: Conjecture 10 (Sendov) Let p(z) = (z −λ1)· · ·(z −λn) be such that |λi| ≤ 1 for all i, and p'(z) = n(z − µ1)· · ·(z − µn−1). Then for any λi there is µj such that |λi − µj | ≤ 1.

accepted.question_text: Let D=diag(λ_1−λ_n,...,λ_{n−1}−λ_n), where λ_1,...,λ_n all lie in the closed unit disk, and let J be the (n−1) x (n−1) all-ones matrix. Determine whether D(I−J/n) must have an eigenvalue in the closed unit disk.

evidence.quote: Conjecture 11 Let D = diag(λ1 −λn, . . . , λn−1 −λn), where λ1, . . . , λn belong to the closed unit disk. Then D(I − J/n) has an eigenvalue in the closed unit disk.

accepted.question_text: Suppose C is an n x n circulant matrix with operator norm ||C||≤1 and λ is an eigenvalue of C. Let C' be the principal submatrix obtained by deleting the first row and first column. Determine whether C'−λ I must have an eigenvalue in the closed unit disk.

evidence.quote: Conjecture 12 Suppose C ∈ Mn is a circulant matrix with kCk ≤ 1 and λ is an eigenvalue of C. Let C' be the principal submatrix obtained from C by removing the first row and the first column. Then C' − λI has an eigenvalue in the closed unit disk.

accepted.question_text: Given real sequences a_1≥⋯≥a_n, b_1≥⋯≥b_n, and s_1≥⋯≥s_n, determine necessary and sufficient conditions for the existence of Hermitian matrices A and B such that A has eigenvalues a_1,...,a_n, B has eigenvalues b_1,...,b_n, and A+iB has singular values s_1,...,s_n.

evidence.quote: Problem 8 Determine the necessary and sufficient conditions on a1 ≥ · · · ≥ an, b1 ≥ · · · ≥ bn and s1 ≥ · · · ≥ sn for the existence of Hermitian matrices A and B so that A has eigenvalues a1, . . . , an, B has eigenvalues b1, . . . , bn, and A + iB has singular values s1, . . . , sn.

accepted.question_text: Given complex numbers a_1,...,a_k and b_1,...,b_n, determine necessary and sufficient conditions for the existence of normal matrices A in M_k and B in M_n whose eigenvalues are exactly those prescribed numbers and such that A is a compression of B.

evidence.quote: Problem 9 Determine the necessary and sufficient conditions on the numbers a1, . . . , ak and b1, . . . , bn for the existence of normal matrices A ∈ Mk and B ∈ Mn so that the matrices have these numbers as eigenvalues and A is a compression of B.

accepted.question_text: For the numerical range W(A) of a matrix or operator A and for any polynomial p, determine the smallest constant k such that ||p(A)|| ≤ k sup{|p(μ)| : μ∈W(A)} holds for every matrix or operator A.

evidence.quote: Problem 10 (Crouzeix) Let p(z) be a polynomial. Find the smallest k such that for any matrix or operator A kp(A)k ≤ k sup{|p(µ)| : µ ∈ W(A)}.
